notes.content: Dated typewritten letter to Murre. The opening sends a ramification-data sketch and annotated manuscript, recommends revising paragraphs 1 to 5, gives advice on layout and citations, and queries the wording about primitive nth roots. Six proposed section headings follow. The lower paragraph retains sections 6 to 10, suggests a paragraph 11 on the tame variant of Lefschetz’s theorem, and ends during a request to check what paragraph 1 needs. No signature or authorial page number is present on this image.
